objective: Abrir Gate12N exclusivamente como UAT/Operational Readiness READ_ONLY en Development, despues del cierre CERTIFIED 100% COMPLETE de Gate12M. Auditar con evidencia exacta que falta para ejecutar una UAT humana real desde la UI de Cava de Socios usando autenticacion, RBAC, unidad/empresa autorizada, frontend, API, servicio y SQL reales, sin mocks y sin realizar todavia ninguna mutacion. Debe producir un mapa GO/NO-GO por precondicion: ruta y navegacion UI, endpoint/base URL Development, sesion/autenticacion, permisos CAVA_SOCIOS_VER y CAVA_SOCIOS_EDITAR, usuario SQL canonico, unidad_negocio_pk y EmpresaID resolubles, socio elegible, estado Persona/PersonaVinculo, mensajes/confirmaciones UI, observabilidad/logs, estrategia de datos UAT y cleanup/rollback. No crear Persona, no vincular/desvincular socio, no DDL/DML, no Production, no ampliar arquitectura.

queries.name: identity_guard
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS db_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login;

queries.name: eligible_socios
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) AS EmpresaID,NumeroSocio,NombreCompleto,PersonaID,Activo,Estatus FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE Activo=1 AND Estatus=N'ACTIVO' ORDER BY FechaCreacion,SocioID;

queries.name: persona_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_personas FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona;

queries.name: persona_vinculo_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_vinculos FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo;

queries.name: cliente_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_clientes FROM dbo.Cliente_Catalogo;

queries.name: active_users_with_public_uuid
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS active_users_with_public_uuid FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo WHERE Activo=1 AND PublicUUID IS NOT NULL;

queries.name: cava_permissions_catalog
queries.sql: SELECT PermisoID,Codigo,Nombre,Activo FROM dbo.RBAC_Permisos WHERE Codigo IN (N'CAVA_SOCIOS_VER',N'CAVA_SOCIOS_EDITAR') ORDER BY Codigo;

queries.name: persona_fk
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND fk.name=N'FK_CavaSocios_Socios_GobiernoPersona';

queries.name: child_fk_integrity
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS trusted_child_fks FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (N'CavaSocios_Botellas',N'CavaSocios_Cargos',N'CavaSocios_Movimientos') AND pc.name=N'SocioID' AND rc.name=N'SocioID' AND fk.is_disabled=0 AND fk.is_not_trusted=0;

constraints: No new tables columns migrations or sources
Use canonical unidad_negocio_pk and EmpresaID relationships
EDARSAHUB SQL Server remains canonical source
Audit SQL only through canonical readonly connection
